senses.definition: n.pr.f. wife of Joseph (𝔊 Ἀσεννεθ, 𝔊L Ἀσσενεθ; Egyptian, = belonging to (goddess) Neith (Thes); CookSpeaker’s Comm. i.479 proposes either As-Neit, favourite of Neith, or < Isis-Neit) Gn 41:45, 50; 46:20.
